payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for evaluation in various tasks, including NMT and image captioning.

claims.text: For English-to-German (En-De) translation, the dataset used is the WMT 2014 dataset with around 4.5 million sentence pairs, validated with newstest 2013 and tested with newstest 2014.
For English-to-Vietnamese (En-Vi) translation, the dataset is from IWSLT 2015, consisting of 133K sentence pairs, validated with tst2012 and tested with tst2013.
For image captioning, the Microsoft COCO 2014 dataset was used, containing 123,287 images with 5 descriptive sentences each, evaluated on the MSCOCO 2014 test set.
For German-to-English (De-En) translation, the IWSLT 2014 dataset was used, with a training set of 160K sentence pairs and a test set of around 7K sentences.
